translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Youdulela tolula kasi kwama

E metoya wotunu eiyoudulaisi metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu deli bweyani iyoudulaisi kwama yaminibwaita paila tolula bisisikomasi tutala biuwotetilasi olumoulela matabudona Bomikikila. Matausina iyoudulaisi tolula kwamala paila Eroni, makawala avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.
Matausina iyoudulaisi miyana epodi metoya karekwa yakakalaia iyoudulaisi metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu, deli bweyani; deli wotunula metoya goula.
Matausina ikatupitukwaisi goula e itaiyasi yasisikwa paila biyoudulaisi olumoulela karekwa yakakalaia deli sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu, deli bweyani.
Matausina iyoudulaisi yayu wotunula miyana epodi e ibisitukwaisi opapala miyana epodi, e gagabila bipilakavataisi deli miyana epodi.
E duriduri makwaina eikimidagaisi kala bisibasi, eibisikaisi metoya youdila makwaisina wala, ibisitukwaisi deli miyana epodi gagabila bivigaki yatinidesila wala, makawala Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.

Matausina ikatubiasaisi dakuna yagasi kaneliani e ikatuginiginaisi mapilasina dakuna goulawokuva wala, matausina inagaisi taitala tokataraki dakuna kala youdila, e itaiya otupwasi mapilasina dakuna yagasi Yekobe litula, tailuwotala taiyu.
E isipwaisi mapilasina dakuna owotunu miyasina ovitakola, e ipilakavataisi miyana epodi paila kabotuvitusila dala Isireli dilaluwotala dilayu; makawala avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.
Youdulela tolula kala kuwa
Matausina iyoudulaisi kwaitala kuwa metoya youdila makwaisina wala leiyoudulokaisi miyana epodi deli kala katuginigini makawala wala.
Kala maloula deli kala beiyaya makawala wala, deli ikatupokaisi pilayu, kala woloula ima okabotakuwa, e kala beiyaya makawala wala.
E itakasaisi kwaivasi dakuna kwevivivila otapwala mapilana. Kasamatala makasana itakasaisi dakuna makwaisina, kwaitala rubi, kwaitala topasi, deli kwaitala ganeti,
e kasayuwela, kwaitala emerodi, kwaitala sapaya deli kwaitala daimoni;
kasatolula, kwaitala tekwesi, kwaitala ageiti, deli kwaitala ametisi,
kasavasila, kwaitala berili, kwaitala kaneliani, deli kwaitala yasipa. Makwaisina dakuna ikatuginiginaisi goulawokuva wala.
E kweluwotala kwaiyu dakuna itaiyasi odubasi yagasi Yekobe litula, paila kabotuvitusila dala Isireli dilaluwotala dilayu.
E kuwa mapilana wotunula iyoudulaisi metoya goulawokuva wala, iviraisi makawala yuwoyoula kala viriviri.
Iyoudulaisi kwaiyu kakalougwa goulawokuva wala, e ikatupitukwaisi makwaisina wa kuwa okaipagala owokulula kwaiyu walakaiwa.
Oluvi isipwaisi miyasina yayu wotunu goulawokuva okakalougwa makwaisina
e matalaga makabulosina kabuloyu wotunu isipwaisi okailasau makavisina, e bogwa goli makawala baisa, ibisitukwaisi makavisina omatala miyana wotunula epodi.
Iyoudulaisi kwaiyu tuvaila kakalougwa goulawokuva, e ibisitukwaisi wa kuwa okaipagala owokulula kwaiyu watanawa, baisa goli kaipagala olumoulela ambaisa bikanapituki miyana epodi.

E iyoudulaisi kwaiyu tuvaila kakalougwa goulawokuva, e ibisitukwaisi makwaisina osikowala miyasina wotunula epodi miyana omatala bila katitaikinela kuvilu okaipagala epodi, e odabala makwaina duriduri leikimidagaisi kala bisibasi.

Makawala avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese, matausina ikauwaisi wotunu kala vau burum, e isipwaisi okakalougwa makwaisina eibisitukwaisi wa kuwa, e ilaga okakalougwa makwaisina eibisitukwaisi deli miyana epodi, e kuwa mapilana isila wala odabala makwaina duriduri e gala gagabila bikapusi.
Youdulela mimilisi tuvaila kasi kwama tolula
E kwama miyana epodi eivakalupoli ibasaisi yamwaidona wala yaburum metoya sipi unuunula.
E itabolusi walakaiwa paila pwaneta, e ponana maponinana kaipagala iviraisi ipoupou taga bidadaimi.

E okabulumwaisala miyana, ikisonusi kala puluweiwa metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu, toyo bweyani, e deli ikalumolaisi makwaisina isaili bela kekikekita goulawokuva wala, makawala avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.
Matausina iyoudulaisi mimilisi kwama;
kulupaipi, kulupewa, sevalopula,

deli duriduri metoya karekwa yakakalaia eiyoudulaisi metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau burum, dairarugu, deli bweyani sipi unuunula paila Eroni deli litula; matausina ibasaisi kasi katububula deli ikatuginiginaisi, makawala Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.
E iyoudulaisi kwaitala saveva metoya goulatoula, makwaina goli kabotuvitusila kaboma kwebumaboma e itaiyasi otapwala biga mabigasina, “Takabomaisi baisa Guyau.”
E wotunula saveva makwaina yaburum isipwaisi omatala kulupaipi makawala avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.
Guyau la Buliyoyova ivigimkulovaisi kala youdila
E komwaidona paisewa Guyau ola Buliyoyova bogwa eivigimkulovaisi. Mina Isireli iyoudulaisi vavagi komwaidona avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.
Matausina imiakaisi Mosese katuvala Buliyoyova deli komwaidona guguwala, kala kailasau, makaisina kokola, mabubosina pou, kokolela deli ulilaguvasi;
katuvala miyana eiyoudulaisi metoya sipi nammwala kanuvinesi, yayuwela miyana eiyoudulaisi metoya mauna kanuvinesi; deli tabodala makwaina;
Kabutu Didawogala makwaina eididagaisi mapilasina dakuna, katikewala, deli katubukolela makwaina;
tebeli makwaina deli goli komwaidona guguwala, deli beredi baisa leivigakaisi lula baisa Yaubada;
kaitapa la kabototu leiyoudulaisi metoya goulatoula, makaisina kaitapa, deli komwaidona guguwala, e kevakevala kaitapa makaisina,
kabogwabu lula makwaina eiyoudulaisi metoya goula, vaputuma bulamila, bulami maiina saina simasimina; e miyana tabodala Buliyoyova kala lulu;
kabogwabu lula makwaina paila lula kwegubugabu, deli kevalela makaina barasiwokuva wala olumoulela; katikewala deli komwaidona guguwala; makaina kailuya kabowina deli la kabototu;
miyasina taboda paila papala, kokolela deli ulilaguvala, miyana taboda paila lulu tabodala; makaisina kenubiluma deli yuwoyoulela Buliyoyova deli papala;
deli miyasina yamatabwaila kwama paila tolula bisisikamsi avai tuta biuwotetilasi olumoulela matabudona Bomikikila miyasina kwama yabumaboma paila tolula Eroni deli goli litula.
E mina Isireli bogwa eivagaisi komwaidona paisewa makawala Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese.
Mosese igisi komwaidona vavagi makwaisina e ibani matausina bogwa eivagaisi makawala Guyau eikaraiwogi. Mapaila ikabwaili matausina.
